sealing_blockers.needs: named external checkpoint versions and their identities

sealing_blockers.blocked_on: resolved 2026-09-15 by reading the active vocabulary

resolution.correct_convention: no BOS; EOT stop set {65531, 0} plus eos_token_id
resolution.method: read the vocabulary artifact rather than choosing a convention
resolution.why_it_matters: a prior line in this program treated 65530 as EOS; because the chat prompt ended with a code fence, completions opening with a blank line were truncated to nothing and pass@1 was exactly 0.0 on 164/164 tasks across three rounds

secondary_endpoints.failure_reading: infeasible cells retained; no physical-edge conclusion
secondary_endpoints.threshold: complete feasibility/precision/context matrix with measured total memory

secondary_endpoints.failure_reading: empirical hypothesis or limited theorem only; label unsupported premises

secondary_endpoints.threshold: quality gain at matched total compute including policy-selection overhead

statistics.correction: Holm step-down across declared primary comparisons
statistics.quality_non_inferiority: one-sided 95% lower bound of candidate-minus-baseline >= -1 percentage point
statistics.reporting: per-seed values, never only a significance label

stopping_rules.saturation: preregistered stress pass; continue past the latency SLO while retaining every memory/error/isolation limit; stop after two increments improve raw completion throughput by <5% or at concurrency 128; mark all SLO violations; a still-rising curve at 128 is a lower bound, never a proven peak
stopping_rules.sustainable: stop at the first SLO/quality/memory/error failure, or after two successive concurrency increments improve qualified goodput by <5%; report the last passing level and all failure reasons
stopping_rules.underpowered: label the interval underpowered rather than invent a tail estimate

test_access.confirmation_access: sealed before model selection; no teacher, retrieval index, or policy may read confirmation answers or hidden tests
test_access.result_tables: released checkpoints and controlled training are separate tables; published checkpoint comparisons are external validity, not same-data causal comparisons
test_access.silent_truncation: forbidden; OOM and unsupported lengths remain in tables as failures
test_access.task_selection: frozen at sealing; changing it after unsealing invalidates confirmation
